title: Took over as director of Great Wall Motor in 1990 and led the company
statement: Took over as director of Great Wall Motor in 1990 and led the company through privatization in 1998 and a Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing in 2003.
outcome: GWM became one of the top ten Chinese automobile manufacturers, publicly listed and privatized under Wei's leadership.

title: Diversified GWM into multiple vehicle brands and formed a 2019 joint
statement: Diversified GWM into multiple vehicle brands and formed a 2019 joint venture with BMW Group to produce electric Mini vehicles in China.
outcome: GWM sold 1.23 million vehicles globally in 2024 and 1,323,672 vehicles in 2025 across its multi-brand portfolio, with the BMW joint venture (Spotlight Automotive) operating as part of its electrification push.
